title: Nearly one-fourteenth-power Wick variational and recentering boundary

variational_boundary.power_family: For every fixed beta<1/14 and A>0, E_N<=6gC_N^2-A g sigma_N N^beta eventually
variational_boundary.necessary_recentering: Uniform semiboundedness of H_N-a_N requires liminf (6gC_N^2-a_N)/(g sigma_N R_N)>=1
variational_boundary.excluded_window: Every scalar family with limsup (6gC_N^2-a_N)/(g sigma_N R_N)<1 has spectral bottoms tending to minus infinity
variational_boundary.mosco_failure: Normalized tilt trials lie in the fixed Gaussian unit ball, have weakly convergent subsequences and force fixed-Gaussian Mosco weak liminf failure throughout the excluded window; the weak limit may be zero
variational_boundary.brst_transfer: Tensoring with K1471's normalized degree-zero harmonic BRST vacuum preserves the form values, weak convergence and exclusion window
